szoveg_eredeti:
Yesterday was day one of the Qai x Hugging Face hackathon in Doha

300+ applications, 140 builders in the room

My brothers Aritra Roy Gosthipaty and Younes B. kicked things off with an awesome workshop to get everyone building on Hugging Face.

Crazy to see the level of talent in this country… stay tuned for what’s coming on the submissions, we’ll post all the demos on this account under the space: https://lnkd.in/dmGS83cR 

Today we’ve got two huge workshops:

1- the big boss Sayak Paul on image & video generation with Diffusers at 2pm
2- mr Niels Rogge on running models locally at 5pm

+ a fireside chat with the legend, ex-Cisco CTO Mr Basem Nayfeh 

To all the participants: we’re here all weekend, so grab us anytime you need a hand or some mentorship :)

Lesgoooooooo
